title: eslint src/ exit 2 — Node.js Lint diagnose first
description:
PR #152 canary 抓到 `eslint src/` (via `npm run lint -w node`) exit 2. eslint exit 2 = configuration/parsing error, 不是普通 rule violation (exit 1). 需独立复现看具体错.

**Performer 步骤 (Fact-Forcing)**:
1. `cd node && npm run lint 2>&1 | tee /tmp/eslint.log` (直接跑)
2. 或 `cd node && npx eslint src/ 2>&1 | tail -50`
3. 分析 error 具体是什么: 配置文件缺? plugin 缺? 语法解析错?
4. 如果是配置问题, 修 .eslintrc*; 如果是 rule violation, 修 source 或加 disable

**注意**: 跟 EPIC-141/145 教训一致, 不能假设根因. exit 2 常见原因:
- .eslintrc 缺失或配置错
- eslint plugin (如 @typescript-eslint) 缺 dep
- 待 parse 的文件是 TS 但没配 parser

**追责链**: main 分支 CI 首次真跑 lint, 之前 miao 从没跑.
acceptance: cd node && npm run lint exit 0 或明确报告根因
如果是配置错, 修配置; 如果是 rule violation, master 拍板严格/放宽
本地能跑, CI Node.js Lint job PASS

verification.original_error: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'typescript-eslint' imported from node/eslint.config.js (also missing @eslint/js)
verification.root_cause: Case B - flat config imports @eslint/js and typescript-eslint (v8 unified package), but package.json declared only legacy @typescript-eslint/parser + @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin. Neither @eslint/js nor typescript-eslint were installed.

config_fix_applied.note: Legacy @typescript-eslint/parser@^7 + @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@^7 kept but no longer directly imported (transitively via typescript-eslint v8). Can be pruned in follow-up.

remaining_violations.blocker_reason: Beyond diagnose-first scope - needs master decision on strict/loose per acceptance criterion #2
top_5_examples: src/index.ts:71 no-floating-promises - top-level main() call needs void or await
src/core/worktree-manager.ts:46 await-thenable - await on non-Promise value (real bug)
src/api/routes/*.ts:* explicit-function-return-type - fastify handlers need Promise<X> return

options: A. STRICT: fix all 60 violations across ~15 files (large scope, likely spans multiple sub-tickets)
B. LOOSE: relax rules - e.g. downgrade explicit-function-return-type to warn, disable require-await for fastify handlers (~40+ violations gone)
C. MIXED: fix real bugs (await-thenable + no-floating-promises + 2 no-unnecessary-condition on dag-executor), then downgrade the noise rules
master_decision_needed.performer_recommendation: C. Real bugs (~4 violations) are legitimate correctness issues. explicit-function-return-type on fastify handlers is style noise given TS infers from schema. require-await often indicates future async or interface consistency (safe to warn not error).

resolutions.master_decision: Option A STRICT — 全修 60 violations
resolutions.rationale: 4 real bug + 53 style rule 都要修. 保 CLAUDE.md Rule 1 (Type Safety) + Rule 3 (Error handling) + Rule 8 (Observable) 精神. STRICT 是 KALLAX 长期方向.
resolutions.scope_expansion: 从 config-only 扩到 config + 60 violations fix
resolutions.sub_tickets_planned: EPIC-150-A (4 real bug: await-thenable + no-floating-promises + 2×unnecessary-condition), EPIC-150-B (3 auto-fixable via --fix), EPIC-150-C (27 explicit-function-return-type), EPIC-150-D (14 require-await), EPIC-150-E (残余 wa 12: 3×template + 1×boolean + 1×namespace)
